data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Doria was the name of a nymph who personified the dew. She was a gentle and nurturing spirit, providing sustenance to the earth through her tears. In the Bible, Dorah is a variant of Dorcas, which means 'gazelle,' and is known for her acts of kindness and charity. The name Doria carries the meaning “Dew, gift of the sea” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Doria usually hope their child will grow to embody dew, gift of the sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.
